title: Make Diagonal Resizing less pixel-perfect by copying windows easier implementation
line: Widget popups like Kickoff and the System Tray can now be resized diagonally by grabbing anywhere near a corner, like windows.
explanation: WindowResizeHandler tested each popup edge only within its own frame margin (about 4-5 px with Breeze), so a diagonal resize only happened where two margins overlap. Because the outermost pixel ring is outside the input mask, the usable corner was about 3x4 px. Now a press on an edge within twice the font's 'M' height of a corner (the same corner size window decorations use) also counts as the neighbouring edge, so corners are about 28 px long; edges that cannot resize (next to a panel) stay excluded.

commits.message:
WindowResizeHandler: Make popup corners easier to grab for resizing

Each edge of a popup was only hit-tested within its own margin, so a
diagonal resize needed a press in a corner of a few pixels. Like window
decorations, a press on an edge near a corner now resizes both ways.

BUG: 527999

media.caption: Master: five presses near Kickoff's top-right corner, each dragged up-right. Presses on the edge 9 px from the corner resize only one way; only a 3x4 px spot resizes diagonally.
Fix: the same five presses. The presses on the edge 9 px from the corner now resize diagonally.
Master: press 2 px in from the right edge, 9 px below the corner, dragged up-right: the popup only gets wider.
Fix: the same press and drag: the popup gets wider and taller.

review.text: Expanding the corner resize hit area in WindowResizeHandler is the right layer and directly addresses the accessibility wish, with clear before/after verification on active corners. However, hitTest() applies the corner expansion before masking against activeEdges, so on popups with non-zero margins on inactive edges (such as floating panels), hovering or clicking near a corner along an inactive edge will falsely trigger a resize on the perpendicular active edge. In addition, mutating left/right in the first branch feeds into the second branch, which can cascade on very small popups.
changes: Mask initial edge hits against activeEdges in WindowResizeHandlerPrivate::hitTest() before expanding corners so inactive edges cannot activate perpendicular active edges near corners.
Evaluate the vertical and horizontal corner-expansion branches using the original (unmutated) edge-hit booleans so the first branch cannot trigger the second.

Verify that hovering and clicking along inactive edges near corners (e.g., inactive left edge near top-left and inactive bottom edge near bottom-right on a floating popup) neither changes the cursor nor starts a resize.

reviews.text: Fixes the reported problem at the right layer: libplasma's WindowResizeHandler, shared by all applet popups, now treats a press on an edge within a corner-sized zone as the neighbouring edge too, mirroring how window decorations size their corners (2x font 'M' height). It still respects activeEdges, so edges next to the panel stay excluded, and the cursor shape follows the same hitTest. Scripted before/after presses at exact offsets and the screenshots show diagonal resizing now works 9 px from the corner while far-from-corner presses stay one-directional.
